source_row.extraction_instructions: biasp.org/events/ is ONE Elementor page of free-form blocks 'Title / Date(s): / Location: / CLICK HERE (Fitwise or organiser link)', mixing BIASP meetings with third-party stroke events. No per-event pages: each block becomes a shell keyed by /events/#<slug>, with detail built from the block (the scraper's load of the booking page is ignored). Year-less dates ('13 October') resolve to the next occurrence. Fees are never on the page; the unwrapped registration link is kept as organiser_url / booking_url.

registry_comment: British and Irish Association of Stroke Physicians - single free-form events page, block parser (BaseExtractor, bespoke)

concerns: Skipped: un-labelled promo banners with no event title: the free online IMT careers webinar on Saturday 10 October 2026 (09:30-13:15) and a 'Save the Date 18-19 March 2027' banner with a call for abstracts closing 15 January 2027 (event unnamed on the page). The first is a real BIASP event and is tomorrow; if the owner wants it, add it by hand or a title rule, I would not invent a title.

The page is a hand-edited list: a layout change (a missing 'Date(s):' label) silently drops that block. A 'Date(s)' label count check against the shell count is the safe guard: today 10 labels = 10 shells.

Fees are not on the page for any event (links go to Fitwise / EventsAir / society sites); pricing_tiers is [] and the registration link is stored as organiser_url for the explorer's two-hop follow. Harness COVERAGE therefore fires PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK / SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE / SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT on every event, but those are page-level checks on a page that hosts all 10 events (the 'multi-day' evidence '18-19 March 2027' belongs to the skipped banner), not per-event misses. No fee image tables, no sub-page, no call-for-papers PDFs checked for the events themselves; Registration Closed is shown for the World Stroke Congress and the event is still listed.

Mixed ownership: roughly half the blocks are third-party events (World Stroke Congress Seoul, ESOC Vienna, ELASF Krakow, SBNS, SHARP), kept because BIASP lists them as stroke-community events. Specialty is fixed to Neurology (the site taxonomy has no stroke entry).

booking_url in the detail is the external registration link, source_url (from the shell) stays the /events/#slug key. fetch_html with the default headers is 403 from some IPs (curl without a User-Agent also gets 403); the extractor falls back to the browser's own page.
